verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a CLI, a server and a built-in web UI, so plugging MCP servers in as a tool client is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP, tool calling or connecting external tool servers. The GBNF grammar and server items are adjacent features at most and do not show an MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
